entities.name: Cándida Arias
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cándida Estefany Arias Pérez is a volleyball player from the Dominican Republic, who won the bronze medal with her native country at the 2008 NORCECA Girls' U18 Volleyball Continental Championship in Guaynabo, Puerto Rico wearing the number 15 jersey. She also competed in two Olympics Games for the Dominican Republic.
